C2.rule: comment >=10 chars to suggest a revision

C6.rule: acceptance of revision only by editor role

C8.rule: valid COI statement for moderation (v1 server; v2 evidence/assertion client only)

C9.rule: valid COI statement for revisions, flags, source suggestions (v2 server)

C10.rule: reason >=10 chars to reject a revision

C11.rule: reason required to reject evidence item or assertion

C12.rule: acting organisation must be one of the user's

C13.rule: comment >=10 chars to raise a flag

C14.rule: bot flags duplicate allele registry ids

C15.rule: only flagger or editor may resolve

U16.rule: pending revisions superseded on conflicting acceptance

C19.rule: approvals reset when assertion flagged or evidence rejected

C20.rule: stale base value refused unless forced

C21.rule: rejected item back to submitted on new revision

C22.rule: approval refused while assertion flagged or not accepted

C23.rule: assertion acceptance by editor only, no self-acceptance

C24.rule: approval requires approver role (+COI from v2.7.2)

C25.rule: account required to raise a flag

C26.rule: suggestion set to curated when evidence submitted from it
